notes: Small fix for phones. The date in the header read 'Tuesday, September 1' at every screen size, which is too long to fit next to the title on a phone — it wrapped onto a second line and made the header taller than it should be. On a narrow screen it now reads 'Tue, Sep 1' and stays on one line. Turning your phone sideways switches it back to the full version on its own. Nothing else changed.
